mapper.sql: r.id, r.rule_id, r.display_name, r.enabled, r.event_type, r.plugin_installation_id, COALESCE(i.plugin_id, '') AS plugin_id, CAST(r.job_id AS CHAR) AS job_id, r.severity, r.remark, r.owner_user_id, u.username AS owner_username, r.owner_dept_id AS owner_department_id, d.department_name AS owner_department_name, r.created_by, r.updated_by, r.created_at, r.updated_at

FROM notification_rule r LEFT JOIN plugin_installation i ON i.installation_id=r.plugin_installation_id LEFT JOIN sky_user u ON u.user_id=r.owner_user_id JOIN sky_department d ON d.department_id=r.owner_dept_id
mapper.select: SELECT ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_rule SET enabled=#{enabled}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId}
mapper.select: SELECT WHERE r.enabled=TRUE AND r.event_type=#{eventType} AND (r.plugin_installation_id IS NULL OR r.plugin_installation_id=#{pluginInstallationId}) AND (r.job_id IS NULL OR r.job_id=#{jobId}) AND (r.severity='' OR r.severity=#{severity}) ORDER BY (r.plugin_installation_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, (r.job_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, (r.severity <> '') DESC, r.id ASC
SELECT channel_id FROM notification_rule_channel WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId} ORDER BY channel_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_rule_channel (rule_id, channel_id, created_by) VALUES (#{ruleId}, #{channelId}, #{createdBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE notification_rule SET owner_user_id=#{ownerUserId}, owner_dept_id=#{ownerDepartmentId}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE rule_id=#{ruleId}
